title: Beer Advent Calendar – 24 Beer Bottles as Christmas Tree Ornaments
seo_description: A new tree ornament every day in December instead of decorating everything at once.
descriptionHtml:
December's calendars are made for kids

Advent calendars in the store are chocolate and cartoon characters – the wrong gift for an adult who already has their own beer shelf or brewing gear. December ends up like any other month: nothing to look forward to each day, just a tree hanging with the same baubles as last year until Christmas Eve.

24 beer bottles to hang, one at a time

24 decorative bottles shaped like beer bottles, each with a gold- or silver-colored bottle cap and its own hanging loop – a new tree ornament to take out every day in December instead of a piece of chocolate. No drink and no alcohol in the box: the bottles are decoration, ready to hang straight on the tree. At least five bottle colors in the same box make the tree look different with every day that passes.

What you get

  • A new tree ornament every day in December instead of decorating everything at once.
  • A gift for someone who already has everything – 24 little items in a single box.
  • No sugar rush and nothing that gets eaten too fast: the ornaments stay on the tree even after Christmas.
  • 24 decorative bottles shaped like beer bottles (12 in the grid + 12 in the bottom row according to the supplier's picture)
  • At least five bottle colors: brown/amber, green, yellow, light blue and clear/white
  • Gold- or silver-colored bottle cap with a metal loop for hanging on each bottle
  • The bottles are three-dimensional (the supplier's own term: "Stereoscopic"), not flat figures
  • The bottles are unlabeled – no label or logo
  • Cardboard box 27.94 x 17.78 x 4.98 cm, printed "BEER ADVENT CALENDAR 2025" in gold with a beer stein as the motif
  • Contains no alcohol or drink

Frequently asked questions

Does the calendar contain alcohol or real beer?
No. The 24 bottles are miniature ornaments shaped like beer bottles with nothing inside – pure decoration for the tree, no drink and no alcohol in the box.

Can the bottles be opened and filled yourself?
The supplier hasn't confirmed this. The bottles have a bottle cap and a loop for hanging, but count on them as finished tree ornaments – not as containers to fill.

Are the days numbered in the box, like in a regular advent calendar?
We can't see that in the images we have, so we don't promise any numbered doors. You get 24 bottle ornaments in a box marked for advent – take one out at a time at whatever pace suits you.

Changing your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
